notes.claim: Concentrations in linked brine tanks obey a linear system of differential equations solved through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of its matrix.
The simple solutions of coupled oscillators are called normal modes, and any motion is a sum of them.
For two equal masses on three identical springs, the eigenvectors (1,1) and (-1,1) have eigenvalues k/m and 3k/m.
In the together mode the two masses move as one, so the middle spring is not stretched or compressed.
For i7: with complex eigenvalues, a linked system x′ = Ax meets the same case as second-order equations, so its parts ring as they fade.
For i7: when a drive coincides with a natural frequency of a propulsion shaft, the result is resonant vibration.
